plan.summary: Extract configuration loading from src/main.py into a dedicated src/config.py module, keeping the printed greeting and JSON config format unchanged.
steps: Create src/config.py with a load_config() function that reads and parses the JSON config file
Update src/main.py to import and call load_config() instead of inline json/pathlib logic
Verify the output remains 'Welcome, traveler.' via the lantern-output check
risks: If the working directory differs at runtime the relative path 'config/app.json' may not resolve

from src.greeting import greeting

print(greeting(load_config()["audience"]))
